key_provisions_or_claims: Deletes point 31 and adds point 31a to Annex IV of the RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU.
Exempts lead, cadmium, hexavalent chromium and PBDE in recovered spare parts for repairing or refurbishing medical devices and electron microscopes.
Reuse must occur in auditable closed-loop business-to-business return systems, with each reuse notified to the customer.
Exemptions expire 21 July 2021, 2023 and 2024 depending on equipment type.
Member States must transpose by 28 February 2017 and apply from 6 November 2017.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2016/585 amends Annex IV of the RoHS Directive to exempt lead, cadmium, hexavalent chromium and PBDE in recovered spare parts used to repair or refurbish medical devices and electron microscopes, under closed-loop conditions, with staggered expiry dates.
